exposure: Maternal perceptions about caesarean section deliveries
outcome: Maternal perceptions about caesarean section deliveries
Role of maternal perceptions in reducing neonatal mortality
cohort: 416 pregnant women attending antenatal care at two hospitals in the Upper West Region of Ghana
finding: Majority of women in the study had a positive attitude towards caesarean section if necessary, but lack of formal education, age less than 19 years, and unemployment were associated with poor maternal perception of caesarean section.
